Package org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.awastar.core.solver

Class AwAstarSolver<T>

java.lang.Object
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.awastar.core.solver.AwAstarSolver<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of states handled by the model
All Implemented Interfaces:
Solver
public final class AwAstarSolver<T> extends Object implements Solver
Anytime Weighted A* solver implementation for no-layer decision-diagram based optimization models.

The solver behaves like AStarSolver but orders subproblems using a weighted f = g + weight * h value, trading optimality guarantees for the ability to find and progressively refine solutions faster.
